interpretation.cpu_timing: Initial untrained-change, unfused one-thread CPU screen; not final student or production kernel RTF.
interpretation.fixed_mel: Common unchanged diagnostic criterion, equal crop means; not candidate training loss.
interpretation.overshoot_counts: Sample counts sum overlapping scored crops, not unique physical events. Prefer peak maximum and affected crop/source counts.
interpretation.paired_counts: Descriptive crop differences only. Overlapping crops are not independent trials.
interpretation.quiet: Natural and synthetic reported separately; residual RMS pooled by valid quiet samples.
interpretation.worst_groups: Largest relative raw-MAE change; counts shown. These may be improvements if every group improved.
interpretation.zero_padding_startup: Initial startup table is not used; its padded-tail handling requires the separately corrected diagnostic.
